description: Review probe (#454): the PR only changes the spacing inside a call, on the same one line; main changes an argument. The resolver returns main's line, with the same line count as the PR's: a line count can't tell. It must not be Merged. Since the layout rule (lib/conflict-union.ts layoutMerge), the conflict gets the rule's proposal instead: main's edit in the PR's layout, which the checks Merge. The canned line itself is still never Merged (tests/conflict-verify.test.ts).
